book.name: 2 Abhatɨsarʉʉnikɨ
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ya kabhɨrɨ ya Paaurʉ kwa Abhatɨsarʉʉnikɨ

content: Paaurʉ arasabha bhabhasabhɨrɨ kwa Mungu
Nangʉ abhahiiri bhɨɨtʉ mʉtʉsabhɨrɨ, korereke amangʼana igʉrʉ wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu gangʼehe kʉnyaragana bhwangʉ na gasuukwɨ, chɨmbu gaarɨ kwa niimwɨ.
Mʉtʉsabhɨrɨ korereke Mungu atʉsabhʉrɨ mʉbhaatʉ abhabhɨ, kʉ kʉbha bhatarɨ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakwisirirya amangʼana gayo.
Nawe Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, ne‑moheene, ewe arabhakongʼya imwɨ na kʉbhariibha kurwa kwa Shɨtaani.
Naatu aratoha ubhwisɨgi bhʉkʉrʉ igʉrʉ waanyu, nangʉ mʉrakora garya twabharagɨɨnʼyɨ, na mʉrakaja kʉgakora.
Ʉmʉkʉrʉ akangatɨ zekoro zaanyu mʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwa Mungu na mubhwigumirirya bhwa Kiriisitʉ.
Amaangirijʉ igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉtʉbhu
Abhahiiri bhɨɨtʉ, tʉrabhaswaja kuriina ryʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, mʉtaanɨ na abhahiiri abhatʉbhu, bhanʉ bhatakutuna amiija ganʉ twabhahɨɨrɨ.
Tʉrabhugabhu, kʉ kʉbha imwɨ mwɨzɨ chɨmbu ikwenderwa kwɨga ekerenjo chɨtʉ. Hanʉ itwɨ twarɨ na niimwɨ, tʉtaarɨ bhatʉbhu,
na twarɨ tʉtakurya ibhyakurya kʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi bhʉʉha. Twarɨ tʉrahocha emeremo kwa mucha ubhutikʉ nu umwise, korereke tʉtanyaacha ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi gatɨ waanyu.
Tʉkakorabhu, ɨtarɨ kʉ kʉbha tʉtɨɨndirwɨ kobhona kegero kurwa kwa niimwɨ, nawe tokeenda tʉbhɨ ekerenjo kwa niimwɨ korereke mutwɨgɨ.
Na hanʉ twarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ, tʉkabhaswaja, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ atakwenda kohocha emeremo, atarya.”
Tubhugirɨ amangʼana gayo, kʉ kʉbha twigwirɨ bhareho abhandɨ gatɨ waanyu abhatʉbhu, bhatakokora ryʉryʉsi, nawe bhariisikirya mʉmangʼana ga abhandɨ.
Abhaatʉ bhayo tʉrabharaganʼya na kʉbharecha kʉbhʉnaja bhwʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, bhahoche emeremo kʉbhʉhʉrɨɨru, korereke bhabhɨ ni ibhyakurya bhyabhʉ abheene.
Nawe imwɨ abhahiiri bhɨɨtʉ, mʉtaniha kokora amazʉmu.
Arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ atakwenda kugwata amaswaja gɨɨtʉ ganʉ garɨ mʉnyarʉbha yɨnʉ, mwiyangarɨrɨ bhʉkʉngʼu. Mʉtagwatana nawe, korereke asʉʉkɨ.
Nawe mʉtamorora nchu umubhisa, mʉbhɨ mʉramorecha nchʉ ʉmʉkɨndichanyu.
Amangʼana gʉ ʉkʉraga
Nangʉ, Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wo omorembe umwene, abhahɨ omorembe ibhaga ryʉsi kʉzɨnzɨra zʉʉsi. Ewe abhɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ bhʉʉsi.
Niinyɨ Paaurʉ nɨrabhaandɨkɨra amakeerenʼya ganʉ kokobhoko kwanɨ inyimwene. Ruyo nerwe ʉrʉkaamʉ mʉzɨnyarʉbha zaanɨ zʉʉsi, na nɨmbu nɨhaandɨka.
Ɨbhɨgʉngi bhyʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, bhɨbhɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ.
